control_name: Automated premium-to-GL posting is complete and accurate
control_objective: Premium amounts calculated in the policy administration system post to the general ledger completely and accurately, so that recorded premium revenue is supported by an independent recalculation with no unexplained variance.
risk_addressed: Configuration errors, mapping defects, or interface failures in the automated premium-to-GL posting routine can cause premium revenue to be recorded incompletely or inaccurately, misstating the financial statements.

required_data_elements.business_definition: A premium-bearing transaction (new business, endorsement, cancellation) generated by the policy administration system in the period.
The general ledger posting recorded by the automated premium-to-GL interface for a premium transaction.
The rating/posting configuration governing how premium amounts are calculated and mapped to GL accounts.

method.summary: Independently recalculate posted premium amounts from policy administration source data and reconcile them to the general ledger postings, confirming a 100% match and no unexplained variance.
steps: Pull the population of in-scope premium transactions from the policy administration system for the period.
Export the active calculation/posting configuration used to derive posted amounts.
Independently recalculate the expected premium and GL mapping for each sampled transaction.
Reconcile recalculated amounts to the corresponding GL postings and compute any variance.
Investigate and document any variance; confirm no unexplained difference remains.
method.sampling_rule: Test the full population where feasible; otherwise a statistically valid sample of premium transactions sufficient to conclude on completeness and accuracy.
method.fallback_logic: If either the policy administration source or the general ledger is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any unexplained premium-to-GL posting variance is a control exception.
thresholds.escalation_threshold: Any recalculation mismatch or unexplained variance

pass_criteria: Independent recalculation matches 100% of posted amounts.
fail_criteria: One or more posted amounts do not match the independent recalculation.
exception_handling: Correct the posting configuration or interface and re-test before relying on the control.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter before §302 certification.

actions_on_fail: Notify Financial Systems Analyst and Controller
